coverage.words: Counted from the 1,833 stocks in the daily scoring run (the run checked 1,838 stocks for 2026-10-30 and scored 1,833; 5 had too little data to score and are not counted)

definitions.construction: Each day's move for a name is its closing price that day divided by its own closing price on its previous trading day, minus one. How closely two names move together is measured from those daily moves over the window printed on the page, counting only the days both names traded.
definitions.floor: A pair is shown with a number only when the two names share at least 40 trading days inside the window. The shared-day count is printed beside every pair.
definitions.newness: This way of putting daily price moves together is a new construction of ours and is still being proven.
definitions.universe: The names are the stocks in the daily scoring run, which are stocks listed today, so stocks that stopped trading earlier are not in it.
definitions.window: The window is the most recent 126 trading sessions in the price history on record.

explanation.body: Its current reading is from 2026-10-30. No study record is on file for this page; what it shows is its current reading, updated on its normal schedule.
explanation.summary: Pick up to 10 names and see which of them have moved together and which have moved on their own, so you can tell whether a basket is really spread out or the same move repeated.
